subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
Hey! Nobody likes road construction, but, St. George has some epic successes and my wife and I REALLY, REALLY APPRECIATE it! The sections of Riverside Drive that have been ripped up and replaced recently, first of all, are BEAUTIFUL! Smooth, clean, awesome! And we can't believe how quickly it was done! Wow! Painless!

Please pass this along to anyone involved in that project and tell them THANK YOU!!! I am sure that many of our fellow citizens are equally happy but, unfortunately, people are far more likely to complain than compliment, so I'll speak for everyone else :) and say thank you again!!! :)
